title: Introduce invocation skyline and contextualized kernel metrics
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a compact invocation skyline metric and dashboard for multi-resolution tail analysis; introduces contextual kernel labels to improve attribution. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: debugging long-tail latency and token-cost spikes requires a compact multi-resolution view that ties invocation surface signals (latency, token cost, KV cache hit-rate) to kernel-level context (queueing, slowpath, quantized execution). This PR introduces an 'invocation skyline' metric series and a small set of contextual kernel labels to help SREs and engineers quickly triage tail events.

What this PR does: 1) emits a new compact timeseries (invocation.skyline) that stores per-aggregation-window percentiles (p50/p90/p99) together with a small set of integer-coded kernel contexts to keep cardinality low; 2) surfaces contextual kernel metrics (kernel.context: kv_warm|kv_cold|slowpath|quantized) on the same timeline; 3) adds a dashboard (invocation skyline panel) with an annotated timeline view, sparkline cohorts by kernel context, and an actionable drilldown link to sampled traces; 4) gauges to estimate memory footprint and expected retention in high-throughput tenants; 5) a small sampler tweak to prefer tail-heavy invocations for the skyline ingestion path.

Compatibility and cost: data emitted is additive and guarded behind a feature flag (observability.invocation_skyline). We use compact encodings and reservoir downsampling to limit storage growth; the perf benchmark in this PR shows ~2.4% additional CPU on the telemetry writer at peak ingest and ~6% additional storage for rollups at the default retention in staging.

Changed files (high level): - observability/metrics/skyline_encoder.go (new): compact encoder for percentile bundles - runtime/sampler/kernel_context_extractor.go (modified): extracts kernel context labels from scheduler traces - telemetry/writer/skyline_writer.go (new): ingestion path and reservoir downsampler - observability/dashboards/invocation_skyline.json (new): dashboard panels and drilldowns - docs/observability/invocation-skyline.md (new): explanation and runbook - tests/integration/skyline_integration_test.go (new): end-to-end ingestion -> dashboard smoke test - scripts/prod-migrate-skyline.sh (new): one-time index migration helper

- Hannah Price: "Dashboard looks useful. Consider moving the kernel-context legend above the cohort panel to improve scanability."

CI checks summary: - unit-tests: pass - integration-tests: initial run flaky (timeout on test harness) -> re-run -> pass - lint: pass - dashboard-validate: pass - perf/skyline-ingest: pass (microbenchmark run) - e2e-smoke (staging): pass
